title: Closeness beyond assumed shared wishes

captions.physics: Acting amid still unclear domestic conditions
captions.energy: Demanding matching wishes to feel secure
captions.emotions: Feeling acceptance and openness between you

meaning: Your domestic support sustains closeness when unknown wishes can be clarified and difference need not be taken as rejection of shared life.
text: It may matter to you that a shared home suits both even before wishes are named. The Moon in the physical position of Muladhara appears through actions based on an incomplete picture: you account for an assumed response. The Lovers in energy risk demanding complete agreement of wishes for confidence. The Lovers in emotions want acceptance and openness. Trying to guess a shared option can therefore complicate closeness: neither has explained what is wanted, yet both already test how identically it should be experienced.

For example, you choose where to spend a quiet evening at home. One assumes the other needs the sofa in front of a screen while personally wanting to sit in the kitchen. Suggesting another setting seems an admission of disconnection. **Closeness allows different wishes to be named without guessing.** Direct discussion can produce a shared evening or an understandable change of activities without making every domestic need a test of whether you suit each other sufficiently.

The difficulty is agreeing with an assumed wish and expecting the other to notice hidden discomfort. Acceptance becomes outward conformity, and its tiring effect looks inexplicable. Support grows when both can speak from their own experience while leaving the other’s answer open. Shared home becomes closer through actual participation rather than an obligation to want the same thing in advance without a clarifying word.
